title: Staff Attendance Report
body:
### Staff Attendance Report

Sat, 30 Oct, 2021

[Articles](https://smart-hospital.in/articles)[Reports](https://smart-hospital.in/category/reports)

---

To check Staff Attendance report, go to **Reports > Staff Attendance Report**. Here select the **Role, Month** and **Year** then click on**Search** button. Here you can see attendance details for staff. Also you can download this report as PDF.
